asset.by: fictional, made with a generic AI image tool
asset.alt: A fictional AI-generated LinkedIn graphic: posed pharmacy staff, a magenta-pink color wash and a generic headline

findings.text: The magenta-pink wash reads close to CVS red at a glance, but it isn't in the palette, and the brand doesn't wash photos.
findings.recommendation: Use CVS red, #CC0000, on white and warm gray, with no color wash over photos.

findings.text: "Wellness Starts Here" is a generic line. It doesn't name Joyward or use approved messaging.
findings.recommendation: Start from the approved Joyward positioning and write in the caring, clear voice.

findings.text: A posed group smiling at the camera doesn't match the photography style.
findings.recommendation: Use a candid photo of a real team at work from the photo library.

packaging.title: The right packaging rules in three questions
packaging.sub: {name}'s store-brand packaging runs on pillars, with rules that change by category. A guided path takes anyone from a product's category to its pillar, template, and rules. A searchable library holds every approved package with its metadata and its packaging guideline.
packaging.note: Sample pillars, packages, sizes, and rules built for this page. Not {name}'s own packaging system or guidelines.
packaging.placeholder: Search packaging, e.g., melatonin or 100 ct
packaging.askLabel: A packaging designer asks the brand assistant

carton.logo: Brand band across the top. Fixed on every pillar; current design only.
carton.name: Active ingredient and strength first, then the product name.
carton.claim: One claim from the approved claims library. Anything else moves to the back.
carton.size: Count and dosage form, bottom center.
carton.info: Back and side panels: Drug Facts, barcode, and the How2Recycle label. Design never touches Drug Facts.

bottle.logo: Brand band at the top of the label. Fixed on every pillar.
bottle.name: What it is first, then strength or formula.
bottle.claim: One claim from the approved claims library.
bottle.size: Count or volume, bottom of the front label.
bottle.info: Back label: Drug, Supplement, or Nutrition Facts as the category requires, barcode, and How2Recycle label.

tube.logo: Brand band at the top of the tube. Fixed on every pillar.
tube.name: Product type and finish first.
tube.claim: One claim. Ingredient callouts stay on the back unless approved.
tube.size: Volume in fl oz and mL, above the cap.
tube.info: Back: ingredients, directions, barcode, and How2Recycle label.

bag.logo: Brand band at the top of the bag. Fixed on every pillar.
bag.name: Food name first, flavor second.
bag.claim: One claim, for example kettle cooked.
bag.size: Net weight bottom left, in oz and g.
bag.info: Back: Nutrition Facts, ingredients, and allergen statement, barcode.

box.logo: Brand band across the top. Fixed on every pillar.
box.name: What is in the set, in the seasonal voice.
box.claim: One giftable claim, for example ready to gift.
box.info: Back: contents, care, gift tag space, and barcode.

tree.label: Find my packaging rules
tree.intro: Answer three questions. The path leads to the pillar, the template, and the rules that apply, plus approved packages that already follow them.

steps.q: What category is the product in?
Does the front of pack use photography?

Health.name: Health
Health.blurb: Clarity first: the active ingredient and what it treats lead the front.
rules: Lead with the active ingredient and strength, then what it treats.
The compare-to callout sits top right, never over the product name.
Drug Facts stay on the back panel, untouched by design.
Flat colors only, no gradients.

Wellness.name: Wellness
Wellness.blurb: Calm and clear: the benefit leads, then count and dose.
rules: Lead with the benefit, then count and dose.
Supplement Facts on the side or back panel.
One benefit icon, from the approved set.
Flat colors only, no gradients.

Beauty.name: Beauty
Beauty.blurb: Product-led: the product type and finish lead.
rules: Name the product type and finish first.
Ingredient callouts stay on the back unless approved.
Size in fl oz and mL.
Flat colors only, no gradients.

Food.name: Food
rules: Show the real product, never a styled substitute.
Net weight bottom left, in oz and g.
Nutrition Facts and allergen statement on the back.
Flat colors only, no gradients.

Seasonal.name: Seasonal
Seasonal.blurb: Joyful and giftable: the season leads.
rules: Seasonal art from the current toolkit only.
Leave gift tag space on every gift box.
Retire seasonal art when the season ends.

Photography: Use approved photography from the library. No AI-generated product shots.
Illustration: Use icons and illustrations from the approved set only.

qa.ask: I'm packaging a new pain reliever. Which rules apply?
qa.answer: Start in the **Health pillar** with the **Health carton template**. Lead with the active ingredient and strength, keep the compare-to callout top right, and leave **Drug Facts** untouched.
qa.sources: 3 sources: Packaging - Pillars - Health; Health carton template; Category rules - Pain relief

libraryQa.ask: Which Health packages are still on the previous design?
libraryQa.answer: **2 packages**: Acetaminophen Extra Strength Caplets and Children's Acetaminophen Liquid. I filtered Packaging by **Pillar: Health** and **Design version: Previous logo**.

detailQa.ask: What has to stay fixed on the {name} pack?
detailQa.answer: **The brand band, the name hierarchy, and the facts panel stay fixed.** Color, art, and icons flex by pillar and category.
